table_title: List the countries that joined NATO from 1999 through 2024, including their accession year and capital city.
db_analog: SELECT n.country, n.accession_year, c.capital_city FROM nato_accessions n JOIN national_capitals c ON n.country = c.country WHERE n.accession_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2024 ORDER BY n.accession_year, n.country
temporal_note: Wikipedia pages accessed on 2026-04-23; all rows and capitals re-verified by live source fetch on 2026-06-02. The cited NATO enlargement page explicitly names the post-Cold War accessions in 1999 (Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland), 2004 (Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia), 2009 (Albania, Croatia), 2017 (Montenegro), 2020 (North Macedonia), 2023 (Finland), and 2024 (Sweden); the 2026-06-02 fetch confirmed the verbatim Finland-2023 / Sweden-2024 lines. The Member_states_of_NATO page carries an explicit dated accession table that independently reproduces the identical 16-country set and states "NATO has added 16 more members from 1999 to 2024," and it also confirms the pre-1999 exclusions (12 founders 1949; Greece/Turkey 1952; West Germany 1955; Spain 1982). The capitals were taken from the cited list of national capitals (13/16 confirmed directly on that page; Poland/Warsaw, Lithuania/Vilnius, Croatia/Zagreb confirmed via their entity pages). This instance keeps the full 1999-2024 accession slice.
_extraction_notes: Built by joining Wikipedia sources. The accession-year rows come from the historical enlargement summary on 'Enlargement of NATO' and are corroborated by the dated accession table on 'Member states of NATO' (which also anchors the pre-1999 exclusion boundary). The capital-city values come from 'List of national capitals'. The resulting table is a closed historical slice over NATO accessions from 1999 through 2024, with one capital per country. All 16 rows and capitals were re-verified by live source fetch on 2026-06-02.
